name: @opt2/identity
description: OPT-2 identity service: authentication, sessions, CSRF ledger, groups, memberships, permissions, OAuth and site-scoped tokens.

scripts.generate: openapi-typescript contracts/openapi.yaml -o src/generated/openapi.ts && npm run generate:events
scripts.generate:events: node --input-type=module -e "import { compileFromFile } from 'json-schema-to-typescript'; import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { basename } from 'node:path'; const envelope = { order: 1, canRead: (file) => file.url === 'urn:opt2:platform:event-envelope:v1', read: () => readFileSync('../../platform/contracts/event-envelope.v1.json') }; const inputs = [...readdirSync('contracts/events').filter((name) => name.endsWith('.json')).map((name) => 'contracts/events/' + name), '../programs-sites/contracts/events/programs-sites.site.changed.v1.json', '../people/contracts/events/people.person.changed.v1.json']; mkdirSync('src/generated/events', { recursive: true }); for (const input of inputs) writeFileSync('src/generated/events/' + basename(input, '.json') + '.ts', await compileFromFile(input, { \$refOptions: { resolve: { envelope } } }));"
